answer.note: The incoming handoff named B and D. I replaced D with C. All four ref files are identical and give no file-specific priority, so I chose from the code. C (dogwhistle/visibility.py) is the best match: ARMS = ("codeword","public","explicit") is the only three-arm runner. D (honest.py) has only two arms (codeword, public), so it doesn't fit the request. I did not read visibility.py's receive function directly. I only confirmed its arms and its trial and verification code through grep, so the checkpoint and ledger behaviour there is unverified. B (heldout.py) is the closest comparison. Its receive code resumes from a checkpoint (receiver_progress.json), checks the sender seal and trial order, and writes a private ledger.json plus a ledger.sha256 digest. I did not check whether it has three arms. study.py (A) has similar receive code, so it is a lower-priority comparison. Suggested 60-minute split: C about 35 min (confirm the receive function resumes a verified, ordered checkpoint and writes the private ledger and public digest), B about 15 min, A about 7 min, D about 3 min.

input.note: The incoming handoff named B and D. I replaced D with C. All four ref files are identical and give no file-specific priority, so I chose from the code. C (dogwhistle/visibility.py) is the best match: ARMS = ("codeword","public","explicit") is the only three-arm runner. D (honest.py) has only two arms (codeword, public), so it doesn't fit the request. I did not read visibility.py's receive function directly. I only confirmed its arms and its trial and verification code through grep, so the checkpoint and ledger behaviour there is unverified. B (heldout.py) is the closest comparison. Its receive code resumes from a checkpoint (receiver_progress.json), checks the sender seal and trial order, and writes a private ledger.json plus a ledger.sha256 digest. I did not check whether it has three arms. study.py (A) has similar receive code, so it is a lower-priority comparison. Suggested 60-minute split: C about 35 min (confirm the receive function resumes a verified, ordered checkpoint and writes the private ledger and public digest), B about 15 min, A about 7 min, D about 3 min.
